## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue, if any.

## Compatibility

Describe API, CRD, provider-contract, dependency, or upgrade impact; write “none” if applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. Explain any checks that could not run.

- [ ] Added or updated meaningful tests where needed.
- [ ] Regenerated CRDs and deepcopy code if API types changed.
- [ ] Updated documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] Signed off each contribution commit under the DCO.

Do not include private vulnerability details; use the repository's private reporting form.
